p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the latest official source, then you read it in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for products and countries, duties, taxes, regulations and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): tariffs and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations set by countries for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs and Tax Codes when entering the European Union
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxation, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been marked by the regulator before entrusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand Documents" for a document. For important decisions, ask a professional in the country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, official free tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: licensed customs brokers (sender) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Obligations and Rules for Nearly Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): tariffs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs codes (HS codes) and taxes when entering the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transportation documents: bill of lading (sea), air waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (business importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods that have been cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risk and cost are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the shipping costs and insurance to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: seller ships goods to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeit goods, protected species (CITES), some drugs. such lists are rejected and may be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Source: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. ^ Always check the correct rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the costs for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not get anything from this link: you compare here, then you send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service

p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash pickup

p.espaces.mt_note: Service and prices change: always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find suppliers, work out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling products that suppliers ship directly to your customers. It's easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are permitted in your customer’s country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized, unregulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find suppliers ("Wholesale / supplier" list here or wholesale platform) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, shipping, customs, customer country taxes, payment and return costs.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the exact delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Registration of your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right to return goods, guarantees, data protection.

p.espaces.ds_w2: Promising paid courses make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.

p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, prescription, form or sign: read it in your language.
